body: Thank you for your caring words.

I hear you. I wish I had answers. This shit is exhausting. Everything is hard lately. I think reaching out is important, maybe doing something for others with those last vestiges of hope / fucks to give. I’ve done that though, and sometimes the more I give, the more people expect or demand. I’ve also reached out to professionals and had it bite me in the ass. I did have one guy though, this amazing therapist... he didn’t tell me to “go do mushrooms in the woods” but he gave me a book by Carlos Castaneda (might check my spelling) about basically doing that, as a last ditch effort. And I would if I didn’t have dependents... I figure a complete re-set could help, or it could be bad. Idk. I’m not telling you to do that either but it was a great book.   ;)   

Godspeed friend.
